boundary_rationale: Onset: 25:1 opens with the word-event formula, "וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר" (oshb:Ezek.25.1) — the strict 39-form and the any-form 41-count both, carrying NO dateline, which is the parent P6 seam itself: the collection is nation-ordered, not date-ordered, and this is the first of its onsets. 25:2 supplies the addressee, "בֶּן אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖יךָ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עֲלֵיהֶֽם" (oshb:Ezek.25.2) — "set your face toward the children of Ammon" is the book's first foreign addressee, the class shift that opens parent P6. Close (weighed from both sides): 25:7 ends "לָכֵ֡ן הִנְנִי֩ נָטִ֨יתִי אֶת יָדִ֜י עָלֶ֗יךָ וּנְתַתִּ֤יךָֽ לבג לַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְהִכְרַתִּ֨יךָ֙ מִן הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֖יךָ מִן הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת אַשְׁמִ֣ידְךָ֔ וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה" (oshb:Ezek.25.7), closing on the 2ms recognition variant "and you shall know that I am YHWH" with a SAMEKH immediately after. An earlier internal close sits at 25:5, "וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת רַבָּה֙ לִנְוֵ֣ה גְמַלִּ֔ים וְאֶת בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן לְמִרְבַּץ צֹ֑אן וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה" (oshb:Ezek.25.5), which ALSO ends on a 2mp recognition-family clause ("widatem ki ani YHWH", the wider 21-verse 2mp family the book_strategy sweep names, not the strict 5-verse 2ms list) and carries its own SAMEKH. Per the standing rule that a refrain closes the unit before it, both 25:5 and 25:7 are treated as closes; they are kept in ONE row because 25:6 reopens with a coordinating messenger formula ("כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן מַחְאֲךָ֣ יָ֔ד וְרַקְעֲךָ֖ בְּרָ֑גֶל וַתִּשְׂמַ֤ח בְּכָל שָֽׁאטְךָ֙ בְּנֶ֔פֶשׁ אֶל אַדְמַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל", oshb:Ezek.25.6) against the SAME addressee (Ammon) rather than a fresh nation, so no addressee-class shift separates 25:5 from 25:7. Ahead of this row, 25:8 opens a fresh messenger formula with an addressee change to Moab, which is the row's forward hard seam.

PARASHAH TENSION, weighed from both sides: the SAMEKH in pmarks_Ezek.json sits at 28:24, not at 28:23 — the Masoretic paragraph groups 28:20-24 together, one verse past the content-based cut used here. This row is cut at 28:23/28:24 on the addressee-class shift ahead (Sidon, 2fs, pivots to "the house of Israel", 3mp, at 28:24) rather than on the parashah, per the standing rule that a mark informs and never decides a boundary alone; the tension is disclosed rather than resolved by the mark.

boundary_rationale: Onset: 28:24, "וְלֹֽא יִהְיֶ֨ה ע֜וֹד לְבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל סִלּ֤וֹן מַמְאִיר֙ וְק֣וֹץ מַכְאִ֔ב מִכֹּל֙ סְבִ֣יבֹתָ֔ם הַשָּׁאטִ֖ים אוֹתָ֑ם וְיָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה" (oshb:Ezek.28.24), pivots the addressee from Sidon (2fs) to "the house of Israel" (3mp) — a genuine subject-class shift — and itself closes with a recognition-adjacent clause ("then they shall know that I am the Lord YHWH", with אֲדֹנָ֥י inserted, a variant of the strict 28-verse list). No word-event or messenger formula marks 28:24 itself; the formal re-onset is 28:25's fresh messenger formula, "כֹּֽה אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ בְּקַבְּצִ֣י אֶת בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מִן הָֽעַמִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָפֹ֣צוּ בָ֔ם וְנִקְדַּ֥שְׁתִּי בָ֖ם לְעֵינֵ֣י הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וְיָֽשְׁבוּ֙ עַל אַדְמָתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לְעַבְדִּ֥י לְיַעֲקֹֽב", opening the gathering/restoration promise proper. Close (both sides): 28:26 ends "וְיָשְׁב֣וּ עָלֶיהָ֮ לָבֶטַח֒ וּבָנ֤וּ בָתִּים֙ וְנָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְיָשְׁב֖וּ לָבֶ֑טַח בַּעֲשׂוֹתִ֣י שְׁפָטִ֗ים בְּכֹ֨ל הַשָּׁאטִ֤ים אֹתָם֙ מִסְּבִ֣יבוֹתָ֔ם וְיָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם" (oshb:Ezek.28.26), the strict 3mp recognition formula in its fullest form ("...that I am YHWH their God"), with a SAMEKH immediately after — closing both this row and this part's entire assigned range (Ezek.25.1-Ezek.28.26); 29:1, outside this part, is the next dateline hard seam. PARASHAH TENSION (same as the prior row, viewed from this row's onset side): the SAMEKH in pmarks_Ezek.json sits at 28:24, one verse before this row's onset, which would instead group 28:24 with the preceding Sidon paragraph; disclosed here again rather than resolved by the mark alone.
